{{Top|leg}}
The '''capacitator armor''' was based on an inverse architecture of the [[Droid energized armor Mark II|energized armor]]. This type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] absorbed incoming energy and converted it into usable power for the internal power source of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The rest of the energy was dissipated harmlessly into the immediate area.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, this armor was limited to [[HK-47]].
